outline: To enhance the ability of graduate level students in the engineering field to write quality technical papers, give clear presentations, and communicate effectively in English.
schedule:
Technical Writing 60%
a. Outlining major ideas
b. General sample sentences
c. What not to do. - Common Errors and mistakes.
d. Word processing skills – Equations, tables and graphs.
e. Journal Submission – Following guidelines and responding to reviewer’s comments
Technical Presentation 25%
Technical Communication 15%
